title: Kerala police are investigating Instagram and YouTube 'educational channels' that offer test-paper clues to lure anxious school students taking Onam mid-term examinations
description: An estimated 40 lakh school students  are taking the Onam examinations, which will conclude on August 20. On August 16, the General Education department petitioned State Police Chief to conduct a detailed criminal inquiry into Instagram and YouTube channels that lure students by promising definitive clues about the mid-term Onam test papers
